app.name: NTD-WATCH
app.subtitle: Community Health Intelligence
app.tagline: From community signals to timely public-health action.

banner.demo: DEMO DATA. Every record is synthetic.
banner.auth: Simulated login and roles. Not security controls.

landing.what: A community-level digital system that captures NTD-related symptoms and contextual risk factors, assesses potential risk using demonstration rules, supports referral and follow-up, and turns anonymised community data into GIS-based intelligence for health programmes.
landing.notDiagnosis: NTD-WATCH supports early recognition, triage, referral and programme decisions. It does not diagnose disease.
landing.chwBody: Mobile-first workflow: assess, see a demonstration risk result, refer, follow up.
landing.progBody: Responsive web dashboard for facility, LGA and state users, and the administrator.
landing.limitsTitle: What this prototype does not do

limits.outbreak: Declare outbreaks. Signals are investigation triggers.
limits.validated: Apply validated clinical rules. All rules are demonstration-only.
limits.real: Hold real patient data. All data is synthetic.
limits.integrations: Connect to DHIS2 or other systems.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to the community health worker app.
login.who: You will be signed in as {{label}}.
login.pinHint: Any 4 digits. It is not checked against anything.

start.title: New assessment
start.intro: This takes about five short steps. You will review everything before saving.
start.privacy: No names, phone numbers or addresses are collected. An assessment code is created so you can find the person in your own records.
start.demo: Use made-up information only while this is a demonstration.
start.draftFound: You have an assessment in progress (code {{code}}).

symptoms.title: Symptoms
symptoms.hint: Choose all that apply. Tell the person this is a check for signs, not a diagnosis.
symptoms.duration: How long have the symptoms been present?
symptoms.conflictNone: “None of these” was cleared because a symptom was chosen.

context.title: Risk and exposure context
context.intro: Ask about the last few months.
context.waterContact: Has the person had contact with open water (for example swimming, washing or fetching water from a stream or pond)?
context.animalContact: Has the person had close contact with livestock or other animals?
context.insectBites: Has the person had many insect or fly bites?
context.householdSimilar: Do others in the household or neighbourhood have similar signs?

wash.title: Water and environment
wash.handwashing: Is there a place to wash hands with water and soap at home?
wash.standingWater: Is there standing water near the home?

summary.title: Review and save
summary.intro: Check the information. Use Edit to change anything. Nothing is saved until you press the save button.
summary.saveFailed: The assessment could not be saved on this device.

result.title: Demonstration result
result.noResult: No result could be shown because symptom information was missing.
result.notFound: That assessment is not on this device.
result.recommendReferral: This demonstration result suggests a referral.
result.referralOptional: A referral is optional for this demonstration result.

referral.facilityHint: Facilities in this community’s area. These are fictional.
referral.offline: You are offline. Showing the status saved on this device.
referral.notSyncedYet: This referral has not reached the server yet, so a facility cannot see it.
referral.demoPanel: Demonstration only: act as the facility
referral.demoPanelBody: A real facility worker would update this from their own screen. This button imitates that so you can follow the whole journey.
referral.notFound: That referral is not on this device.

followup.intro: People who were referred, and people advised to be monitored, who have not had a follow-up yet.
followup.attendedFacility: Did the person attend the health facility?
followup.further: You said a further referral is needed.
followup.notFound: That assessment is not on this device.

history.title: Assessment history
history.empty: No assessments saved on this device yet.

profile.title: Profile and sync
profile.syncBody: Changes are saved on this device first, then sent to the mock server when a connection is available.
profile.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting. Every saved change has been sent.
profile.simBody: These switches exist so offline and error behaviour can be demonstrated. They are not part of a real product.

placeholder.body: Navigation, role access and page structure are in place. The content for this screen is built in a later stage.

access.title: Your demo role cannot open this page
access.body: This page is hidden for the {{role}} role. Permissions here are simulated and only shape the interface.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That address does not match any screen in the prototype.

validation.symptoms: Choose at least one symptom, or choose “None of these”.
validation.duration: Say how long the symptoms have been present.
validation.progression: Say whether the symptoms are getting worse.
validation.waterContact: Answer whether the person has had contact with open water.
validation.animalContact: Answer whether the person has had close contact with animals.
validation.insectBites: Answer whether the person has had insect or fly bites.
validation.householdSimilar: Answer whether others in the household have similar signs.
validation.handwashing: Answer whether handwashing facilities are available.
validation.standingWater: Answer whether there is standing water near the home.
validation.personReached: Say whether the person was reached.
validation.attendedFacility: Say whether the person attended the facility.
validation.condition: Choose how the person is now.
validation.needsFurtherReferral: Say whether a further referral is needed.

symptoms.skin_sore_painless: Skin sore that does not hurt
symptoms.limb_swelling: Swelling of an arm or leg
symptoms.eye_pain_vision_loss: Eye pain or loss of vision

waterSource.improved: Protected source (for example a piped supply or protected well)
waterSource.unimproved: Unprotected source (for example a pond, stream or open well)
